findings.fact: A source vhost virtqueue can use multiple DMA vChannels and independent dataplane threads; this supports dispatch groups, not measured native arrival frequency.

Packet completion flags are consumed only as a contiguous completed prefix, then used entries are release-published and guest notified. Same-queue p3 cannot publish before unfinished p1/p2 under matched pre-reservation.

The frozen 60/65/1514B frames share original MAC/flow_id. Logical F0={p1,p2}, F1={p3} is a controlled same-queue dispatch grouping, not two native network flows. Total bytes and layout remain unchanged.
The request FIFO captures the complete idma_req_t on the front handshake; be_trans_complete comes from real idma_rsp_valid, not mere FIFO acceptance.
Normal COUNT moves to WAIT on handshake and DEFAULT retires only on real completion. FIFO depth does not establish a publicly reachable four-job enqueue facility.

With batch and controlled launch disabled, ordinary SRC/DST/NUM_BYTES writes are forwarded during WAIT. Once the old request was actually FIFO-captured, those fields can prepare the next request; CONF/ttype/WDATA remain fixed.

Configuration transactions advance actual model cycles and add a tick after response. Successful NEXT alone is not used as an unverified frontend-capture proof; new trace must establish handshake before ahead writes.

acceptance_conditions: Retain production DID10/11; equal legal device-context fields and shared page table/2MiB leaf for same logical backend owner, identical memory/table budget across cases.
Both single and parallel may prepare next SRC/DST/NUM_BYTES only after actual previous front capture, and trigger only after previous DONE; no fabricated prequeue/bypass.
Parallel uses per-group FIFO with work-conserving progress; a busy group does not prevent another independently ready group from using its idle engine. Used publication stays original p1,p2,p3 order.
Solo cases are matched hardware diagnostics. Inactive buffers/headers remain untouched; source-faithful p3-only prefix publication is not asserted.
Whole single/parallel cases close useful work after all DMA quiet and original-order publication/consumer. Per-group hardware buffer readiness is separate from untimed application delivery.
No new bytes, pressure, cold flush, page-size/identity restrictions or deadlines; no production changes or deployment.
gate_decision: Finite-phase G0 admitted under root/gate-acceptance.json; streaming and native guest-latency claims not applicable. One frozen four-case suite authorized.
